author: IcyCode
body: Ok so the new update has come out with it's fair share of bugs but overall it's a decent update with a fair amount of new gamemodes. Now why are there so few maps with these new gamemodes. Look at how many destroy maps we have in comparison to the other types in the rotation at the moment. Can we even it out a bit please, for example in the Mixed rotation the majority looks like it's Destroy Maps... add some others, a few KOTH maps could be added there as well as some CTF, CTW and whatever other gamemodes you've created. And why don't we have a KOTH rotation?? Apparently it's finished, working, with maps but no server..? Overall tho nice update
